attr.title: MYGAME
attr.desc: Describe the GAME here, as a store page would (not the port). One or two sentences. Runs in the Ruffle Flash emulator; you need the game files from MYSTORE.
attr.inst: Buy the game on MYSTORE and copy everything from its install folder into ports/MYPORT/gamedata/. The first launch patches the game files, which takes a few minutes.
attr.inst_md: Buy the game on [MYSTORE](https://example.com/store/page) and copy everything from its install folder into `ports/MYPORT/gamedata/`. The first launch patches the game files, which takes a few minutes.
